conviction_watchlist.investment_thesis: Sivers 的 100M+ CW DFB 激光产能将其推入 T1 激光器供给梯队（对标 $COHR、住友、古河、$AVGO、$LITE），CIOE 2026 渠道调研确认其与中国可插拔光模块厂合作并本地设点。供给紧张下公司已提价，70mW-200mW 激光 ASP 上行直接支撑毛利率扩张，属跨多日反复验证的结构性卡位。
存储出现"价格零下跌风险"的极端供需：2027-2028 产能基本售罄，2028-2029 晶圆订单已排满，DDR5 供给仅为原预期 80% 以下，价格预计逐季上涨 20-30%。作者明确表态 long memory，并将 MegaFab 投产前的时间窗视为盈利持续超预期区间。
$NVDA 指引 1.3 万亿美元超大规模 capex，GPU 供给受限下仍维持 70-100%+ 同比增长；旧 GPU 续约价 +20% 直接证伪"算力快速折旧"叙事。合约需求已延伸至 2030 年代，从先进封装到存储采购全面锁定。
作者自 2025 年起持续看多激光器，认为 CW 架构切换早于行业共识；Citi 将激光与光纤定位为"下一个 HBM"，紧供给带来稀缺溢价。财报与渠道调研双重确认 70mW-200mW 激光 ASP 上行，2027-2028 光通信超级周期或复刻 2025-2026 存储行情。
SK 海力士以"最低价+无价格上限"的长约结构锁定盈利，产能售罄至 2029，是本轮 HBM/DRAM 紧缺最直接受益者之一。但相关论述多以反驳空头与他人持仓的形式出现，自身仓位表态不如 $MU 明确，故列为建仓级别。
NOR Flash 高容量产品 H2 涨价 90-110%、SLC NAND 涨价 70-150%，$ESMT 以相对体量计是最大受益者（主攻 >256Mb 高密度 NOR）。作者明确称其为"我的想法与持仓"，但仅单一信源、单日提及，暂不足以给核心评级。
50% FCF 利润率、2030 年 80% 毛利率预期使其成为 NAND 涨价周期的弹性标的。但本轮论述主要围绕 Leopold/Situational Awareness 的持仓展开，作者未表达自身建仓意图，属事件驱动型观察。
被列入激光器紧缺受益篮子的知名标的之一，逻辑是光模块与激光供给紧张下的 ASP 上行。但缺乏明确买入或建仓表述，属于主题映射而非独立判断。
作为 T1 激光器供给方被反复对标，同享激光涨价与稀缺溢价。但仅作为产能对比参照出现，未见独立加仓或看好论述。
被提及供给受限下仍维持 70-100%+ 同比增长保护，并兼具激光器与定制 ASIC 双重属性。但属引用型证据，缺乏仓位意图。
Neocloud 需求旺盛（Oracle 旧 GPU 续约价 +20% 转售），但债务利息侵蚀自由现金流，是作者明确表示不认同的少数持仓，属有条件观察。
CEO 表态即使模型不再进步，现有能力的落地也需要数年算力建设，支撑算力租赁长期需求。但目前仅是引用观点与行业判断，无明确建仓表述。
GPU 产能续约全部转售且溢价 20%，利好 neocloud 与 $NVDA，并反驳 GPU 快速折旧论。属单季度财报事件驱动，缺乏持续跟踪。
TPU v9 提升单 GPU 光学含量/光模块 TAM，是光通信需求的来源之一；但 TurboQuant 恐慌被视作短期噪音，缺乏明确仓位表述。
作为 Leopold 买入的期权标的被提及，属于他人仓位映射，本身缺乏作者独立建仓意图。
作为存储主题的 ETF 表达被反复提及，用于描述他人持仓结构，作者未表态自身配置。
被纳入带宽瓶颈/InP 衬底等冷门卡脖子链条的讨论，1 年 3000% 涨幅已反映部分预期，属主题提及而非有依据的建仓判断。
发布 Digit 5 下一代人形机器人，但作者仅以"Thoughts?"抛出讨论，无任何投资逻辑或仓位意图。

tweets.original:
$SIVE has its own piece in Digitimes btw, which is appreciated industry recognition outside of Sweden. 

I think Sivers 100M+ CW DFB laser capacity buildout forced the industry to revisit its models and generated considerably more coverage. 

BC it puts Sivers into T1 laser capacity convo w/ $COHR, Sumitomo, Furukawa, $AVGO, Landmark, and $LITE if it executes on its ramp. 

But outside of that, CIOE 2026 channel checks were really meaningful since the community found Sivers is working with Chinese pluggable players + setting up an office locally. 

I'm getting dejavu to the time I pointed out $SIVE + $JBL at OFC for their 1.6T LRO, but nobody believed the link until there was an actual press release. 

Anyway, proud to see this little company growing up
tweets.translation:
$SIVE 顺便说一句在 Digitimes 有单独报道，这是瑞典以外对其行业认可的体现。

我认为 Sivers 的 100M+ CW DFB 激光器产能扩建迫使行业重新审视其模型，并带来了显著更多报道。

因为它让 Sivers 进入与 $COHR、Sumitomo、Furukawa、$AVGO、Landmark 和 $LITE 的一线激光器产能讨论，前提是它能执行爬坡。

但除此之外，CIOE 2026 的渠道调研非常有意义，因为业界发现 Sivers 正在与中国可插拔光模块厂商合作，并在当地设立办公室。

我有种似曾相识的感觉，就像我之前在 OFC 指出 $SIVE + $JBL 的 1.6T LRO，但没人相信这一关联，直到有正式新闻稿。

无论如何，很高兴看到这家小公司逐渐成长。

tweets.original:
Some color on current memory environments for the $MU / $SKHY bros:

"There is zero risk of memory prices dropping" per Team Group GM Gerry Chen. 

- Memory module makers have received notices warning of drastic cuts to their 2027 supply allocations. Some could receive 50% or less of their 2026 allocation.

- Upstream manufacturers have reportedly sold out nearly all of their 2027–2028 capacity.

- DDR5 supply, in particular, is projected to come in at less than 80% of previous expectations.

- Chen expects prices to continue rising 20–30% quarter-over-quarter into 2027 (source Digitimes)

- Chen's commentary on $MU is that even before their new MegaFab capacity comes online Q4 2027 at the earliest, orders for 2028 through 2029 are already fully booked. 

So that there's virtually no relief in sight to current shortages.  

Sharply lower allocations, fully booked capacity into 2029, and future price hikes doesn't quite sound like the AI buildout is slowing down.
tweets.translation:
关于当前内存环境的一些细节，供 $MU / $SKHY 兄弟们参考：

Team Group 总经理 Gerry Chen 表示：“内存价格下跌的风险为零。”

- 内存模组制造商已收到通知，警告其 2027 年供应配额将被大幅削减。部分厂商可能只能拿到 2026 年配额的 50% 或更少。

- 据报道，上游制造商 2027–2028 年的产能几乎已全部售罄。

- 尤其是 DDR5 供应，预计将低于此前预期的 80%。

- Chen 预计，价格将持续环比上涨 20–30%，直至 2027 年（来源：Digitimes）。

- Chen 对 $MU 的评论是：即便其新的 MegaFab 产能最早要到 2027 年第四季度才上线，2028 年至 2029 年的订单也已全部预订完毕。

因此，当前短缺几乎看不到缓解迹象。

配额大幅下降、产能预订已排至 2029 年，以及未来继续涨价，听起来并不像是 AI 建设正在放缓。

tweets.original:
I've seen comments from Jim Cramer today supporting hedge funds that short Leopold's "nonsense" $SNDK / $DRAM / SK Hynix type calls.  

As well Cramer calling $CRWD a "Must Buy".   

I'm not sure if Jim Cramer sees a $241B company  labelled "Cybersecurity" and thinks of it as safe... while ignoring all their fundamentals. 

But with Crowdstrike, you have a ~145x FY2028 fwd P/E company, growing revenue 26% Y/Y. That Cramer thinks is a "must buy". 

And then you turn your eyes to the AI capex beneficiary theme that Leopold is long on. 

With names like $SKHY / Samsung in $DRAM... Both FY2027 ~2.8-3x fwd P/E off analyst projections.  

-> Samsung LTAs to 2031 (70% capacity) for durability...  -> Minimum price floor + no price ceiling type contracts from SK Hynix.  
-> Memory shortage much tigher for the next year.  
-> DRAM/NAND % of hyperscaler capex goes higher (est. 68% per Trendforce)  
-> 2027 hyperscaler capex projections all hiked.  

Then with $SNDK, 50% FCF margins, 80% gross margin projections into 2030.   

Only Situational Awareness position I'm in disagreement with is $CRWV due to debt interest eating FCF, but I can make a similar bullish argument with $BE, $INTC, $AMD, and others. 

Not quite sure about short-term, but over the medium run: 

It's hard to not see Leopold's positions pulling an Inverse Cramer due to overwhelming fundamentals.
tweets.translation:
我今天看到 Jim Cramer 的评论，支持那些做空 Leopold 所谓“无稽之谈”的 $SNDK / $DRAM / SK Hynix 类看涨押注的对冲基金。

此外，Cramer 称 $CRWD 是“必买”。

我不确定 Jim Cramer 是不是看到一家市值 2410 亿美元、贴上“网络安全”标签的公司，就认为它安全……却忽略其所有基本面。

但就 CrowdStrike 而言，这是一家 FY2028 远期市盈率约 145 倍、营收同比增长 26% 的公司。Cramer 却认为它是“必买”。

然后你再看看 Leopold 做多的 AI 资本开支受益主题。

其中有 $SKHY / Samsung 在 $DRAM 领域的标的……按分析师预测，两者 FY2027 远期市盈率均约 2.8–3 倍。

-> Samsung 长期协议延伸至 2031 年（占产能 70%），提供了持久性…… -> SK Hynix 提供最低价格下限、无价格上限类型的合同。
-> 未来一年内存短缺更加紧张。
-> DRAM/NAND 在超大规模企业资本开支中的占比上升（Trendforce 估计为 68%）。
-> 2027 年超大规模企业资本开支预测全部上调。

再看 $SNDK，预计到 2030 年自由现金流利润率 50%、毛利率 80%。

我唯一不同意的 Situational Awareness 持仓是 $CRWV，因为债务利息侵蚀自由现金流，但我也可以对 $BE、$INTC、$AMD 等提出类似的看涨论点。

短期不太确定，但中期来看：

很难不认为，由于基本面压倒性强劲，Leopold 的持仓会上演“反向 Cramer”。

tweets.original:
$IREN CEO on Anthropic call for frontier slowdown:

“Even if models never improved from here…

just rolling out what they can already do would take more compute than the world can build for years”

I agree, and current narrative is reminiscent of the $NVDA DeepSeek selloff or the $GOOGL TurboQuant scare. 

Guess what happened? 

These scares once or twice a year all turn out to be immaterial to the overall AI buildout.

Especially when we have contracted demand all the way into the 2030’s now from advanced packaging to memory procurement.
tweets.translation:
$IREN CEO 就 Anthropic 呼吁放缓前沿发展发表评论：

“即使模型从此不再进步……

仅仅部署它们现在已能做到的事情，所需的算力也将超过世界未来多年能建设的规模。”

我同意，当前叙事让人想起 $NVDA 的 DeepSeek 抛售，或 $GOOGL 的 TurboQuant 恐慌。

猜猜发生了什么？

这些每年一两次的恐慌，最终都被证明对整体 AI 建设无关紧要。

尤其是当我们如今从先进封装到内存采购，都已锁定延伸至 2030 年代的需求。

tweets.original:
I assign essentially 0% probability that Anthropic or OpenAI will slow down frontier development in any meaningful way. 

And that majority of the "regulation" they try making is regulatory capture to slow down competition. 

1. Anthropic/OpenAI will not willingly hand over their lead to Gemini, xAI, Meta, or another frontier lab.

-> Elon will want a slowdown to catch up with OpenAI. 
-> OpenAI will want a regulatory framework to slow down xAI + competition. 

Every lab has an incentive to support rules that constrain competitors more than they constrain itself

2. The US is not going to meaningfully slow frontier AI development while China continues advancing. (as seen with Trump's post today about rejecting AI slowdown). 

It would be probably the most flagrant national security risk if China leapfrogged the US in capability. 

Especially when both sides have called frontier AI capabilities "cyber nuclear weapons" 

3. China will not slow down frontier AI development. That is a given. 

It will be theater if any of these parties agrees so publicly, because behind the scenes:

-> They'll likely keep on progressing, whether it's OpenAI, the US Government, or China. 

If they wanted to slow down, they could have done so themselves at any point in time: 

Yet everyone is still fighting over the scarce resources to run AI as seen with memory procurement from Samsung going all the way to 2031. 

Or the $NVDA / $AVGO supply constrained 70-100%+ Y/Y growth protections.

So I suggest people unfollow the clowns on X that predict AI stocks from $NVDA to $TSM to $MU will crash for engagement. 

All this does is cause retail to panic short term and hand over the keys to the kingdom over to others.
tweets.translation:
我认为 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 以任何有意义的方式放缓前沿发展的概率基本为 0。

而且，他们试图制定的“监管”大多是为了减缓竞争的监管俘获。

1. Anthropic/OpenAI 不会心甘情愿把自己的领先优势拱手让给 Gemini、xAI、Meta 或其他前沿实验室。

-> Elon 会希望放缓，以便追赶 OpenAI。
-> OpenAI 会希望建立监管框架，以减缓 xAI + 竞争。

tweets.original:
Anthropic's Economic Scenario publication was a pretty interesting read:

1. Anthropic's "extreme" scenario has GDP growth reaching 15.4% in 2030

So around 7.3x current rates (~2.1% Y/Y), which is consistent with what Elon Musk is saying about outgrowing the national debt with AI.  

2. Almost all of the divergence happens after 2027. 

Their model shows relatively little separation in 2026-2027, then the curves bend sharply into 2028-2030. 

So my read is that it points to 2026-2027 as buildout years and 2028-2030 as economic acceleration. 

Kinda gets mapped as well when you look at $AMZN / $META / $GOOGL capex, and short term FCF headwinds (but massive projected profitability post 2028)

3. In an extreme scenario, unemployment of knowledge workers goes to 17.9%. With 11.9% economy-wide unemployment

"At the individual level, it means coders and call service center agents may have to switch to jobs like electrician and nurse, which are less exposed to AI."

GG computer science majors. 

4. Non-cognitive wages: +33.6% vs. baseline in an extreme scenario. 

So your electricians/construction-type labor becomes extremely valuable? (but this isn't factoring in humanoids yet...)

Whereas -11.5% for knowledge workers in 2030 vs. baseline. 

5. Aggregate capital income is ~81% higher than it would have been without AI

Productivity explodes -> aggregate labor income barely changes -> essentially all of the incremental GDP accrues to capital.

So that makes ownership of capital rather than labor... so equities like compute, power, semis, networking, robotics, etc. become pretty important... 

TLDR:

- Economic growth go brr
- Jobs that require thinking = unemployment + lower wages
- Physical labor = more important, like electricians. 
- AI equities go brrr.
tweets.translation:
Anthropic 的经济情景报告读起来很有意思：

1. Anthropic 的“极端”情景中，2030 年 GDP 增速达到 15.4%。

这大约是当前增速（约 2.1% 同比）的 7.3 倍，与 Elon Musk 所说的 AI 让经济增速超过国家债务增长相一致。

2. 几乎所有分化都发生在 2027 年之后。

他们的模型显示，2026-2027 年差异相对较小，随后曲线在 2028-2030 年急剧弯曲。

所以我的解读是，它指向 2026-2027 年是建设期，2028-2030 年是经济加速期。

当你看看 $AMZN / $META / $GOOGL 的资本开支，以及短期 FCF 逆风（但 2028 年后预计盈利能力巨大）时，也能大致对应上。

3. 在极端情景下，知识工作者失业率达到 17.9%，全经济失业率为 11.9%。

“在个人层面，这意味着程序员和呼叫服务中心客服可能不得不转向电工、护士等受 AI 影响较小的职业。”

GG 计算机科学专业学生。

4. 非认知型工资：在极端情景下较基准增长 33.6%。

所以电工/建筑类劳动力变得极其有价值？（但这还没有把 人形机器人 因素考虑进去……）

而 2030 年知识工作者相较基准为 -11.5%。

5. 总资本收入比没有 AI 的情况下高约 81%。

生产率爆发 -> 总劳动收入几乎不变 -> 本质上所有增量 GDP 都归于资本。

这让资本所有权而非劳动力变得……因此算力、电力、半导体、网络、机器人等股票变得相当重要……

TLDR：

- 经济增长一路狂飙
- 需要思考的工作 = 失业 + 更低工资
- 体力劳动 = 更重要，比如电工。
- AI 股票一路狂飙。
